name: Toolbar
summary: A row of related actions, or a control or status with its actions: one gap, the start part growing, the actions wrapping without overlap. The row draws no enclosure, so its buttons stay as they are. Not for an app's identity and global actions (use TitleBar) or for a choice between options (use SegmentedControl).
a11y: A plain `div`, not `role="toolbar"`: its buttons are reached with Tab like any others. Each action names what it does; an icon-only one has its name as its tooltip.

props.name: children
props.description: The actions, at the end of the row; they wrap onto more lines rather than overlap. None: the start part takes the whole row.

props.name: start
props.description: A control or a short status the actions belong to, at the start; it takes the room that's left.

props.name: align
props.description: `end` lines the actions up with the bottom of a labelled control; `center` with a line of text.
